back: The splitting of white light into its colours, because each colour is refracted by a different amount.

front: Colours of the spectrum in order?
back: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet.
Red: longest wavelength, lowest frequency, refracted least. Violet: shortest wavelength, highest frequency, refracted most.

front: Why does a prism disperse white light?
back: Each colour travels at a slightly different speed in glass, so each refracts by a different amount.
Light of a single frequency (one colour).
No: they are already in white light; a second, inverted prism recombines them into white.
